sentences.ar: آخر يوم بالسنة، إجا كل الأهالي.
sentences.en: On the last day of the year, all the parents came.

sentences.ar: الأستاذ كان قاسي معهم طول السنة.
sentences.en: The teacher had been harsh with them all year.

sentences.ar: كان عنده شعر مستعار على راسه.
sentences.en: He had a wig on his head.

sentences.ar: من فوق، نزلت قطة معلقة بحبل.
sentences.en: From above, a cat came down hanging on a rope.
It lifted off the wig and rose with it.
The hall burst out laughing and the summer began.
